summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iron & Neon Gym website with admin membership management system. Backend APIs are working well (91.7% success rate), public pages load correctly, admin authentication works, but found issues with member form validation and session management.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for member creation
minor_bugs.impact: Minor - functionality works but status code inconsistent

ui_bugs.issue: Membership plan selection not working properly - shows 'Invalid membership plan' error even when plan appears selected
Admin session expires quickly, redirecting to login page during navigation

integration_issues.issue: Form validation fails for membership plan selection despite UI showing selection

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section and navigation
Plans page displays 3 membership plans correctly
Trainers page shows 4 trainers with photos and details
Contact page loads with functional form
Admin login works with correct credentials
Admin dashboard displays stats and charts correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix membership plan selection in Add Member dialog - the Select.Item component is not properly setting the value, causing form validation to fail. Also investigate admin session timeout issues.
